rules.title: Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO) - allowable annual rent increase
rules.requirement: For covered older rental units, rent may be raised only once every 12 months by the annual allowable percentage set by the city (3% for 7/1/2025-6/30/2026). Since Feb. 2, 2026 no extra percentage for utilities or for an added dependent is allowed; a 10% increase for an additional non-dependent tenant is still permitted. RSO and SCEP surcharges may be passed through only after registration and written notice.
rules.key_value: Once per 12 months, annual allowable percentage published by LAHD (3% for 7/1/2025-6/30/2026)
rules.citation: L.A. Mun. Code ch. XV, § 151.00 et seq.
rules.quoted_span: Rent may be increased once every 12 months by the allowable rent increase percentage
rules.effective_date_note: Date of the current formula changes (no utility or dependent add-on) per LAHD; the underlying RSO is much older and its original date is not in the documents.
rules.coverage_conditions: Rental properties first built on or before October 1, 1978, plus replacement units under LAMC 151.28.
rules.exemptions: Condominiums/townhomes: rent not regulated for tenancies commencing after Dec. 31, 1995. Luxury exemption by application.
rules.interaction: Local RSO governs instead of the state cap (Cal. Civ. Code § 1947.12) for covered units.
rules.conflict_note: Two published effective dates for the new formula: LAHD says 2026-02-02; a landlord association reportedly published 2026-01-24. LAHD date used.

rules.title: Los Angeles RSO - just cause, eviction notices and relocation assistance
rules.requirement: Landlords of RSO units may evict only for listed at-fault or no-fault reasons. Eviction notices must be filed with LAHD within 3 business days; no-fault evictions need a prior Declaration of Intent to Evict and relocation assistance paid within 15 days of notice ($11,000-$27,400 per unit for 7/1/2026-6/30/2027, reduced for Mom and Pop owner/family occupancy; Notice of Right to Counsel must be attached to eviction notices).
rules.key_value: Just cause required; relocation $11,000-$27,400 per unit (7/1/2026-6/30/2027)
rules.quoted_span: No-fault evictions require the payment of relocation assistance
rules.effective_date_note: Original effective date not stated; right-to-counsel notice required from 2025-08-20; current relocation amounts effective 2026-07-01 and increase each July 1.
rules.coverage_conditions: Rental units subject to the RSO (generally first built on or before Oct. 1, 1978).
rules.exemptions: No relocation when replacing a resident manager with another or for natural-disaster hazards not caused by landlord negligence; landlord may offset owed rent.
rules.penalty: Failure to file the Landlord Declaration makes the eviction a violation of the RSO; tenant may raise nonpayment of relocation as an affirmative defense.

rules.title: Los Angeles Just Cause for Eviction Ordinance (JCO)
rules.requirement: For most LA rental units not covered by the RSO, a landlord may end a tenancy only for listed at-fault or no-fault reasons, with relocation assistance for no-fault evictions (same schedule as RSO; one month's rent for qualifying natural-person single-family owners). Nonpayment evictions are barred unless the amount owed exceeds Fair Market Rent for the unit size, and eviction notices must be filed with LAHD within 3 business days.
rules.key_value: Just cause required; relocation assistance for no-fault evictions ($11,000-$27,400 per unit, 7/1/2026-6/30/2027)
rules.quoted_span: It prohibits terminations of tenancies without just cause and requires relocation assistance for no-fault evictions
rules.effective_date_note: No effective date for the core JCO is given; FMR nonpayment threshold effective 2023-03-27; Notice of Right to Counsel posting from 2025-08-20.
rules.coverage_conditions: Most residential properties not regulated by the RSO, including newer buildings and single-family dwellings; tenant must have lived in unit 6 months or original lease expired.
rules.exemptions: Transient hotels, licensed care facilities, fraternity/sorority houses, owner's roommate, certain cooperatives, some non-profit facilities, some HACLA/government properties.
rules.interaction: Applies to units not covered by RSO; does not regulate rent increases (state AB 1482 may apply).
rules.review_note: Municipal code section inferred from LAMC 165.03/165.06 cites in the relocation bulletin; the JCO page itself gives no section.

rules.title: Los Angeles Resident Protections Ordinance: demolition for new construction
rules.requirement: When Protected Units are demolished for new construction, owners must pay the higher of State Housing Crisis Act or City relocation. Lower-income households get standardized payments of $87,450 to $115,480 under Option 1, plus a right to remain up to 6 months, 6-month notice, right to return and right of first refusal.
rules.key_value: $87,450 (low), $96,750 (very low), $115,480 (extremely low) per unit under Option 1
rules.citation: L.A. Ordinance Nos. 188481 and 188482 (Resident Protections Ordinance)
rules.quoted_span: On February 11, 2025, the Los Angeles City Council adopted the RPO which codified and expanded upon replacement requirements and occupant protections of the HCA
rules.effective_date_note: Bulletin says RPO effective 2/11/2025 under Ordinances #188481 and #188482.
rules.penalty: Financial penalties starting at $250,000 per displaced unit and withholding of LAHD permit clearances.
rules.interaction: Applies only to Protected Units demolished for new construction; other units follow regular RSO/JCO relocation rules.

requires_unknown_facts: unit is a Protected Unit (RSO unit, or rent-restricted or lower-income occupied within the past 5 years) being demolished for new construction

rules.title: LA RSO security deposit interest requirement
rules.requirement: Landlords of rent-stabilized units must pay tenants accrued interest on security deposits, monthly or yearly, as direct payment or rent credit, and tell the tenant in writing which method they chose.
rules.key_value: Interest paid monthly or annually; rate set annually by the City (4.32% for 2025)
rules.quoted_span: A tenant shall be given the unpaid accrued interest in the form of either a direct payment or a credit against the tenant’s rent
rules.effective_date_note: Interest began accruing November 1, 1990, per the quoted code text.
rules.coverage_conditions: Properties subject to the Los Angeles RSO.
rules.penalty: Non-compliance can be raised as a defense in eviction proceedings (per source article).
rules.review_note: Source is a landlord-association article quoting the code; LAHD RSO page also lists interest on security deposits as an RSO subject.

unverifiable_exemptions: single-family homes, condos and other RSO exemptions cannot be verified from parcel data

no_rule_findings.finding: Only a September 2024 council motion instructing LAHD to report on algorithm-based rent-setting software and the feasibility of a ban; no enacted ordinance at the city level.
no_rule_findings.quoted_span: I THEREFORE MOVE that the City Council instruct the Los Angeles Housing Department to report on the number of ownership and management entities that are using algorithm-based software to establish rents and the feasibility of instituting a ban on the use of this software to set rents in the City.

parsed.notes: LA: no documents provided for application/screening fees or screening restrictions; none added. Candidate n3 dropped because the city has an RSO rent-limit rule. D038 (LAMC) was link-only and not used.
